page.title: Today
page.purpose: Answer 'what can I usefully do now?' and 'what needs my attention?' with a single next-action surface, scoped capacity, and commitment notices — fully usable manually before any automation, provider, or model is configured.

priorities.statement: The single next useful action is unmistakable: one dominant Start focus, a quieter Open source, and a session objective distinct from the task's full completion criteria.
priorities.notes: Avoid more than one primary action (plan §6.2, §7.1).

priorities.statement: Capacity is honest and scoped: 'Xh planned / Yh available / Zh breathing room' only when all three use the same accounting model; unknown estimates show as '3h known + N unestimated'.
priorities.notes: Never claim all white space is usable capacity (plan §7.1, §10).

priorities.statement: The Observatory scene creates a sense of place without ever competing with the task text, capacity numerals, or timeline; contrast holds in its brightest and darkest regions.
Time geometry on the day timeline is truthful — block width is proportional to duration and the now-indicator is accurate.

states.description: Shell and cached context resolve promptly, then the day; 'updating' is shown separately from 'no data'.
A next action, scoped capacity, commitment notice, and a truthful day timeline are visible.
No tasks: offer capture, routine setup, or optional source connection — never a fabricated personal plan.
Some tasks are unestimated: capacity shows known time plus an explicit count of unestimated demand.
Demand exceeds room: show the known excess and unknown demand with a review action.
Nothing fits the next window: explain the limiting window/block/missing estimate and offer a smaller session or another task.
A forecast is stale: mark why and recompute when possible; never present an old result as current.
A load failed: keep the accepted schedule visible; a provider or forecast outage never blanks the whole app.
